notes.title: Version 1.2.0 - One Month Already!
notes.content:
It's been a month already! Thank you to everyone who has been playing and providing feedback. We've been hard at work incorporating your feedback/fixes and following our last major update that overhauled all NPC decks, this next phase focuses on improving all the effects and AI systems.

[b]Version 1.2.0[/b]
[list]
[*] Reworked all effects in the game using our new testing platform, we’ve checked and tested every effect in the game - everything is working properly now. There may be some edge cases, but please let us know and we'll handle them quickly. 
[*] Updated some card effect descriptions to make them clearer.
[*] Completely changed some card effects like Granite Grasp, Boomley, Sea Trade and more. making them more useful and viable in gameplay.
[*] Upgraded the AI making it more of a challenge.
[*] Fixed a bug in AI behavior that caused it to leave points unused when it should have been able to act.
[*] Resolved an issue were saving and loading back into a tournament wouldn't properly update the board state.
[*] The shop in the void will now appear 99% of the time during each run.
[*] Changed clone cards' cost to zero, preventing them from being used to summon champions.
[/list]

[b]Looking Ahead:[/b]
Now that we're in a fully stable state, we're focusing on adding achievements next, along with controller support. We don't have a firm deadline for these features, but we're actively working on them.

As always, we'll continue fixing any edge cases and bugs through regular patches.
Thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: One Week Post Launch Update
notes.content:
First, thank you to everyone who has played Card Summoner during its first week on Steam. This project has been a labor of love, inspired by YGO: Forbidden Memories, while creating our own unique experience.

[b]What we've heard so far[/b]

[list]
[*] Bugs at launch: Like any complex release, we shipped with more issues than we'd hoped. Hotfixes have gone out daily, and stability is already much better. We're sorry to those who hit the rough edges first.
[*] Card balance & synergy: A few cards feel underpowered or useless to some people. Once the major bugs are behind us and we are in maintenance mode we'll look into improving cards over time as we play and just enjoy the game.
[/list]
________________________________________

[b]Why we built the game[/b]

Story-based, single player CCGs are a small niche, precisely why we dove in. No one else was making the game we wanted to play, so we did. While we don't expect to see many other single-player CCGs out there, we hope others will create some too. We're happy with the experience we created and hope it shows.

[b]Roadmap:[/b]

[b]1.0.x[/b] - Quick fixes until 1.1.0.

[b]1.1.0: [/b]In testing	
• Smarter NPC decks to match the improved AI
• Effect fixes
• More balancing.

[b]Beyond 1.1:[/b]	
Monthly Regular maintenance patches: bug fixes, balance tweaks, QoL improvements.

We have no plans for multiplayer or paid DLC. If inspiration strikes, we may add content, but we won't make any promises.

________________________________________

[b]A note on VR[/b]

The other spark behind Card Summoner was VR. We'd love to duel on a giant battlefield like Season 1 YGO, so we'll keep experimenting with a VR port - just a small battle area, nothing huge. This would be more of a fun side project for our own enjoyment. If it works out, we'll share it for free since it's super niche and just a small slice of the full game experience.

________________________________________

Again, thanks to everyone—whether you praised, critiqued, or simply played.

See you in Greenhaven!

notes.title: Launch Follow-Up and What's Next
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

First, thank you so much for playing and supporting Card Summoner!
It's been amazing seeing players explore the world we've built.

We tested extensively with a small group before launch and felt confident — but as always, once the game reaches more players, more unexpected issues pop up.

We appreciate everyone who has taken the time to send feedback, report bugs, and suggest improvements.

We're a small two-person team, and we’re actively working through all the reports and fixing issues. Some fixes may take a little extra time because we want to test everything properly before patching — the last thing we want is to accidentally create new problems while fixing others!

If you don't see a fix right away, just know we’re working hard behind the scenes and prioritizing stability and quality.

Thank you again for your patience and support — it truly means a lot.

This is just the beginning, and we’re committed to making Card Summoner the best experience it can be!

- Fixed issue with summoner decks not showing up in deck builder. (Once unlocked in game)
- Fixed bug where you would be locked and stuck with the deck builder
- Fixed issue where leave button would show up in void throne room.
- Fixed bug where creating a new deck deletes old deck.
- Updated Some fonts missing characters.


*Objectives are bugged we are currently fixing it.

We are actively working on your feedback thanks!

notes.title: We’re Officially Launched!
notes.content:
[h2][b]We’re Live![/b][/h2]

The full version of Card Summoner is now officially available!

Thank you to everyone who supported us through development, played the demo, and followed along during the final push. Your feedback, encouragement, and patience helped make this possible.

We took our time testing thoroughly, but as with any launch, there may still be issues that pop up. If you see anything, please report it — it helps a lot! (You can use the in-game feedback form, available in the pause menu.)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068020/eb2b9556aa533fc141c7350c3e8e32689f924e4d.png[/img]

We’re already working on updates to improve card balance and address anything else we find. As always, we'll take the time to test updates carefully to make sure the game stays balanced and stable.

We’ve also launched with a 15% discount as a thank-you for everyone's support!

We're active on Discord — feel free to join if you want to chat, share feedback, or just hang out!

notes.title: Launch Update — We’re Live Monday 04/28/25!
notes.content:
Launch Update — We’re Live Monday!

Hey everyone — thanks again for your patience over the past couple of weeks.

We’re happy to announce that the full release is locked in for this Monday at 10AM EST!
The final build is uploaded, tested, and ready to go. Everything is set.

We know the wait was longer than planned, and we really appreciate everyone being patient and to say thanks, we’re increasing the launch discount to 15% instead of the originally planned 10%.

The base price will be $19.99, with the 15% discount active at launch!

notes.title: Quick Launch Update
notes.content:
Hey everyone — just a quick update as we get close to release.

There’s been a slight delay. Steam has officially approved the build, so that part’s done. We also added features like deck purchasing based on community feedback, which is fully implemented.

During final testing, we started hitting some bugs late in the game and other edge cases. Right now, we’re focused on smoothing out those issues to ensure performance and gameplay flow feel right. We could release as-is, but we already know we’d get complaints about problems we’re aware of, so we’re taking the time to catch what we can now.

This isn’t going to be a long delay. It’s just difficult to give an exact time because every time we’re confident, something else shows up. The goal is simple: get through a full start-to-finish playthrough without bugs. Once that happens, we’re ready. Anything found after that should be rare and can be patched post-launch.

Thanks again for your patience, we’re almost there!

[i]Hopefully it’s clear we’re not just delaying for the sake of it. We want to deliver the best player experience possible before moving on to other projects. It’s not just about getting it out, but getting it right.[/i]

🔔 For updates, feel free to join our Discord or Wishlist the game. Steam will notify you the moment we go live.

notes.title: New Launch Date: April 16 @ 12PM EST
notes.content:
Hey Summoners!

Things have been going well with development — the game is ready, and we’re just finishing up a few last-minute fixes. Our previous build didn’t pass Steam’s checks due to some store languages not being fully implemented yet, and a few credit formatting issues.

We’ve already fixed everything and resubmitted, but we won’t make the 04/14 release in time. Instead, we’re moving the launch to 04/16/25 at 12 PM EST to give Valve time to approve and to run one last round of polish and localization checks.

If you notice your language missing at launch, don’t worry — we’re just waiting on the final localized files and will re-add them shortly after release. In the meantime, we’re using this extra time to squash any last bugs and make sure everything is as smooth as possible.

Thanks for your patience — we’re almost there!

notes.title: Enter The Void – A New Way to Play & Demo Updates!
notes.content:
Hey Summoners, it's time! As we draw closer to completion, we want to explore The Void - one of our most exciting features.

[b]About the Demo[/b]

The demo starts in Greenhaven, giving you a perfect taste of what's coming in the full game. We've made countless improvements, including:

[list]
[*] Completely reworked AI systems
[*] Rebuilt deck building from the ground up
[*] Fully implemented shop systems
[*] Enhanced dialog systems
[/list]

And so much more that you'll need to experience for yourself
We'd love to hear your feedback! If you encounter any issues, please report them through the in-game system, Discord, or Steam community forums.

[b]What is The Void?[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068020/5add7f57d1722d6e4364890a1187aa428f2cdf8d.jpg[/img]

The Void is a mysterious place between worlds that you'll discover more about as you play. But let's talk about what makes it special from a gameplay perspective.

We created The Void to solve a common card game problem - what to do with all those extra cards from boosters that usually just collect dust. In The Void, these cards become your arsenal for a completely different kind of battle.

[b]Here's how it works:[/b]

[list]
[*] Build separate decks specifically for The Void
[*] Summon creatures from these cards to fight alongside you
[*] Cards will be destroyed after several uses - that's the price of bringing them to life
[*] Your main dueling deck remains untouched - this only affects cards in your Void deck
[*] Cards can't be in both a normal deck and a Void deck simultaneously
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068020/e713be428e2b04f0369ad5a8751bc906b15c5e0c.jpg[/img]

Don't worry about running out of cards - you'll get plenty from booster packs to support both play modes. Just be strategic with your rarest cards!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068020/8fc395ee0daf6e258d939f666fd24fd45c10c250.jpg[/img]

[b]Gameplay in The Void[/b]

Think roguelike meets monster battles. Each time you enter The Void, you'll encounter:

[list]
[*] Randomly generated maps
[*] Various room types including healing chambers and treasure rooms
[*] Traditional monster battle system where cards are used for summoning and enhancing
[*] Direct control over attacks, offering a refreshing break from standard card battles
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068020/ee813e177ca2247f94c3048e1f7310e328b1e2ed.jpg[/img]

The Void puts incredible strain on your cards - they're creating echoes of real monsters, after all. But here's the exciting part: with the Sphera Abyss, you can capture actual monsters and add them to your collection! The Void truly is a place of mysteries.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068020/d3b1ddb9c3c9125a1b1e16b667d92d79af196b54.jpg[/img]

[b]Development Update[/b]

We're in the final stretch! Some of you have asked why we haven't moved faster, but here's the truth: we're working every day to make this game exceptional. Right now we're:

[list]
[*] Polishing every feature
[*] Squashing bugs
[*] Fine-tuning dialog
[*] Running thorough testing passes
[/list]

Yes, it takes time, but we believe you'll appreciate the attention to detail. The demo should give you an excellent taste of what's coming. If you're a card game fan like us, you're in for something special!

notes.title: News - The Path to Tournament Glory!
notes.content:
Hey Summoners! The journey to becoming a Grand Summoner is taking shape. Each update gets you closer to the ultimate challenge, so here’s what’s new.

[b]Complete In-Game Rulebook[/b]

Knowledge is power! The in-game rulebook is here, covering all the game rules and glossary. While the story does a solid job of explaining things, this fills in any gaps for those who want all the details.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068020/9fde53d5d1ccaf04d1ee14df4bf1c25d2737366e.png[/img]

[b]Combat Ranks[/b]

A new ranking system tracks how you did in each match, helping you see your progress and improve over time. Think of it as a way to prepare yourself for the Grand Summoner Tournament. Full stats will be available in Ammonipedia later.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068020/9471dc3208d4ae53aaabc40cba369ac34326c6b2.png[/img]

[b]Enhanced Deck Builder[/b]

The deck builder has been getting upgrades. Most changes are behind the scenes, but one you'll notice—deck summaries. Now you can get a quick breakdown of your deck’s composition at a glance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068020/0e0a12aed9014f31c1016f8cb140fb0146e1b0d0.jpg[/img]

[b]Other Updates[/b]

• [b]Alternate Card Art[/b] – More cards to collect, whether you're catching or opening packs!

• [b]In-Game Feedback & Bug Reporting[/b] – Automatic error reporting is still there, but now you can send feedback directly in-game if you spot something or have suggestions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068020/eb2b9556aa533fc141c7350c3e8e32689f924e4d.png[/img]

[b]🏆 The Grand Summoner Tournament 🏆[/b]

The final stage is revealed—The Grand Summoner Tournament. Inspired by real-world card conventions and tournaments, this is the ultimate test of everything you’ve learned.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068020/391b480b304703347bbfb5f41baa1ef8d8b1ac40.jpg[/img]

Next time, we’ll show how capturing monsters works and give you a peek into the mysterious void. Stay tuned!

notes.title: Demo Update 0.5.3 -> 0.5.4
notes.content:
[h2]Update v0.5.4[/h2]

[b]Major Changes and Improvements[/b]

• Combat System Overhaul: Significant improvements to the combat system, addressing numerous issues with summoning that could cause the game to freeze.

• Effect System Update: Expanded from 10% to 90% of all 100 effects, overhauling the effect system to better handle bugs and reduce freezing.

• AI Enhancements: Fixed bugs that caused the AI to attempt to play cards in the same spot, improving overall AI behavior.

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

• Resolved an issue causing the game to freeze at the start of combat when cards were not being drawn.

• Various fixes and improvements to reduce unexpected errors and improve stability.

[b]Testing and Future Improvements[/b]

We've implemented an extensive testing system where the AI battles against itself with different decks each night 100s of times. This helps identify bugs that we can fix to ensure a more stable experience.

In the next patch, we'll add an Error Reporting System, providing an option to send error reports directly when issues occur. This will save time gathering logs and help us catch edge cases more efficiently.

We're also adding a Feedback Box for you to share your ideas and suggestions, helping us shape the game based on your input.

In the end, all these fixes and improvements aim to create a more stable, faster, and overall better experience for our players.

notes.title: Thank You for Trying Our Demo During Next Fest!
notes.content:
First, a big thank you to everyone who gave our demo a try during Steam Next Fest! Your feedback and support mean the world to us, and we're excited to keep improving the game based on your suggestions.

We want to clarify that this demo only showcases [b]1 of the 6 villages[/b] and doesn’t include the full story or context. 

Some key features, like the fort where you can duel other summoners and [b]enter tournaments[/b], access to the world map, and one of the most important mechanics, [b]Summoner Battles[/b], where you [u]fight monsters and capture them to turn into cards[/u] for later duels, are not part of the demo.

We’re constantly working to add more features and fix any bugs found along the way, so please stay tuned for updates! Also, note that saved progress won’t carry over, as we expect significant changes moving forward, and we want to avoid the complications of building a migration path for demo saves.

Thank you again for being part of this journey with us. We’re excited to bring more of the world to you soon!
